full_judgment: 14. Mr Md Ahsanullah, learned Advocate for convict Md Babul (appellant in Criminal Appeal No. 3245 of 1991) attacks the conviction of his client on the grounds that there is no direct or circumstantial evidence against his client to connect him with the murder when the alleged illicit connection of his client with Dalima was not admitted rather denied by Dalima herself, that PW 2 and PW 5 can not be the reliable witnesses as being partisan and that the charge-sheet witness Abdur Razzaq and mother of Dalima having not been examined the legal adverse presumption will be against the prosecution for withholding them.
